career_ladder.note: Judicial officers in Jammu & Kashmir are recruited under the Jammu and Kashmir Civil Service (Judicial) Recruitment Rules, 1967 and subordinate judicial regulations in consultation with the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. Pay scales and career progression follow the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) uniform pay matrix mandated by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India (WP(C) 643/2015), progressing through Assured Career Progression (ACP) stages and promotions up to Principal District Judge and constitutional elevation to the High Court.

exam_scheme.note: The Jammu & Kashmir Judicial Service (Civil Judge Junior Division / Munsiff) Competitive Examination is conducted in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective Type screening test consisting of Paper A and Paper B, total 450 marks), Main Examination (Conventional descriptive written test comprising 6 compulsory papers and 3 optional papers of 100 marks each, total 900 marks), and Viva-Voce / Interview (140 marks), determining final merit out of 1,040 marks.

stages.source_label: JKPSC Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination Rules & Scheme

papers.paper_name: Paper A: General Knowledge, Indian Constitutional Law, Criminal Laws & Limitation Act
papers.negative_marking: 0.33 mark penalty (1/3rd deduction for each incorrect response)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening examination to shortlist candidates for Main Examination; marks not counted for final merit

papers.paper_name: Paper B: Civil Laws, General Financial Rules, Kashmir Service Regulation & Subordinate Court Guidance Rules
papers.negative_marking: 0.33 mark penalty (1/3rd deduction for each incorrect response)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening examination to shortlist candidates for Main Examination; combined score in Paper A and Paper B determines Mains shortlist

stages.source_label: JKPSC Civil Judge (Junior Division) Main Examination Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Compulsory Paper I: English Essay, Translation (English to Urdu/Hindi and vice-versa), and Precis Writing
Compulsory Paper II: General Knowledge and Indian Constitutional Law
Compulsory Paper III: Criminal Law & Procedure (Code of Criminal Procedure / BNSS, Indian Penal Code / BNS, and Evidence Act / BSA)
Compulsory Paper IV: Financial Code (Vol. I & II), Kashmir Service Regulation, and Subordinate Court Rules & Orders
Compulsory Paper V: Civil Law & Procedure (Code of Civil Procedure 1908, Limitation Act 1963, and Registration Act 1908)
Compulsory Paper VI: Transfer of Property Act 1882 and J&K Residential and Commercial Tenancy Act 2012
Optional Paper 1: Personal Laws (e.g. Hindu Law and Muhammadan Law)
Optional Paper 2: Mercantile & Civil Obligations (e.g. Law of Contract and Law of Torts)
Optional Paper 3: Equity, Trusts, Specific Relief, and Jurisprudence

stages.source_label: JKPSC Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination Viva-Voce Rules

papers.qualifying_threshold: Candidates shortlisted for interview in approx. 1:3 ratio of total advertised vacancies based on aggregate marks in Main Examination

financial_package.note: Judicial officers in Jammu & Kashmir receive compensation fixed under the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) uniform pay matrix as accepted by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India (WP(C) 643/2015). Civil Judge (Junior Division) / Munsiff begins at Pay Level J-1 (₹77,840 - ₹1,36,520) along with official judicial allowances and perquisites.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) Report & High Court of J&K and Ladakh
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from Level J-1 entry basic ₹77,840 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹45,147) + judicial HRA (9% to 18% depending on city or designated rent-free official judicial quarters) + judicial allowances including sumptuary, robe, medical, conveyance, and residential orderly allowance. In-hand estimate reflects standard statutory deductions including 10% NPS (Basic + DA), GIS, and applicable income tax.
official_perks: Designated official judicial accommodation / rent-free residential bungalow in posting district
Sumptuary allowance and robe allowance per SNJPC recommendations
Conveyance allowance / official vehicle with driver and fuel entitlement for court inspection duty
Comprehensive medical facilities and reimbursement for officer and dependent family members
Subsidized electricity and water consumption up to prescribed monthly units
Residential orderly / attendant allowance and official telephone/broadband reimbursement
